verdict.rationale: The founder describes Zero as an AI email client that auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies and lets users chat with their inbox, which covers in-product insights and suggestions from the user's own mail. The repo docs also list asking questions about mailbox content and specific threads, plus AI-assisted composing. Missing for 10: first-party docs describing the in-app insight and suggestion UX (the documented Q&A is listed under the MCP surface), depth of summaries and suggestions, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
